verdict.rationale: Framer is a website builder that hosts user content, so exporting all of it in open formats is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents CSV import into the CMS and migration from other builders into Framer, but no export of sites or CMS data in open formats. External-agent read access to CMS collections and the Server API are developer building blocks, not a documented export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
